title: tRPC OpenAPI: buildOpenAPIDocument fails with undefined procedure meta

error_signal.message: trpc TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'method') in buildProcedureOperation when procedure has no openapi meta defined

ground_truth.root_cause_description: buildProcedureOperation accesses procedure.meta.method without checking if meta exists. When a procedure doesn't have openapi meta defined, it crashes.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add null check for procedure.meta before accessing method property in buildProcedureOperation
